column1: !!SBtab TableID='QuantityOrientationDependence' TableType='QuantityInfo' TableName='Dependence of quantities on the orientation of reactions' SBtabVersion='1.1'
% How the value of a quantity changes if a reaction is written in the opposite direction (substrates and products exchanged).
% Used to convert data tables into the reaction orientation of a model (sbtab_orient_data_table.m, Metabolic Network Toolbox).
%   none:    the value does not change
%   sign:    the value changes its sign (x -> -x; Min and Max are exchanged)
%   inverse: the value is inverted (x -> 1/x; Min and Max are exchanged; GeometricStd does not change)
%   swap:    the value becomes the value of another quantity (column !SwapWith)
standard Gibbs free energy of reaction
